title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War
description: For as long as he can remember, Ichigo Kurosaki has been able to see ghosts. But when he meets Rukia, a Soul Reaper who battles evil spirits known as Hollows, he finds his life is changed forever. Now, with a newfound wealth of spiritual energy, Ichigo discovers his true calling: to protect the living and the dead from evil.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: The Soul Society is observing a sudden surge in the number of Hollows being destroyed.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Arrancars Nel Tu and Pesche Guatiche have come to seek Ichigo’s help explaining that Hueco Mundo is under attack by an unknown enemy. Unable to ignore the situation, Ichigo and his friends decide to set out for Hueco Mundo.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and his friends arrive in Hueco Mundo to confront Quilge Opie and learn that their latest enemy are Quincies.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The Wandenreich mobilizes its elite force, the Stern Ritter, to annihilate the Soul Society. Creating massive flaming pillars of Reishi as a distraction, the Stern Ritter easily enter the Soul Society to bring carnage to the Soul Reapers.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Quilge Opie uses his power to imprison Ichigo inside the Garganta. As he tries to break free, Ichigo begins to hear, through his Soul Phone, the screams of the Soul Reapers falling to the enemy's onslaught.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto confronts Yhwach for the first time in a thousand years. As Yhwach finally draws his sword against Genryusai, the Soul Reapers notice an abnormal change taking place across the Seireitei.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto learns that the Yhwach he defeated was an impostor. The real Yhwach then reveals himself and easily kills Genryusai, sending a wave of shock and devastation across the Soul Reapers.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Rescue efforts are being made across the Seireitei to find and help those who've survived the Stern Ritter attack. Meanwhile, Ichigo meets with Mayuri Kurotsuchi about fixing his broken Tensa Zangetsu.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Squad Zero brings Ichigo back to the Royal Palace to prepare for the coming battle. Meanwhile, Kyoraku is appointed as the new Head Captain to lead the Thirteen Court Guard Squads.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Kenpachi Zaraki removes his eye patch to fight Retsu Unohana, a.k.a. Yachiru Unohana, “The First Kenpachi.” Meanwhile, Ichigo and Renji head to Hoohden to meet Oh-Etsu Nimaiya, the man who is said to have created the Zanpakuto.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Ichigo is kicked out of the Royal Palace by Oh-etsu Nimaiya for failing his test. When Ichigo next opens his eyes, he finds himself standing in front of his house in the World of the Living.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Squad 10 Captain Isshin Shiba of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads decides to not report his encounter with the Quincy named Masaki Kurosaki in the World of the Living to the Head Captain.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Ichigo learns that he is the child born of a Soul Reaper and a Quincy. Finally understanding the truth behind his heritage, Ichigo decides to return to Hoohden with a renewed resolve to finish what he has started.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Ichigo prepares to leave the Royal Palace to return to the Seireitei but is stopped by Hyosube, who claims that Ichigo cannot defeat Yhwach as he is now.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Yhwach sets his plan to end the world in nine days in motion.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Mayuri receives a call from Urahara, who had stayed behind in Hueco Mundo.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: The Stern Ritters drive the Soul Reapers deeper into a corner.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Kensei Muguruma joins the battle against Masculine.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: A fearless Rukia takes on Äs Nödt.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Isane and Yachiru are attacked by Gwenael.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Candice, Meninas, Giselle, and Liltotto try to take down Kenpachi.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Ichigo tries to stop Yhwach upon learning that his real target lies within the Royal Palace.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Ikkaku, Yumichika, and the Arrancars work together to fight off Giselle’s zombies.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Yhwach finally enters the Royal Palace.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Yhwach confronts Hyosube, who is protecting the real Royal Palace.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Yhwach performs Auswählen to bestow power to his fallen Royal Guards.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: The battle between Squad Zero and Yhwach's Royal Guards for the Soul King rages on.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and his friends hurry to the Reio Greater Palace to stop Yhwach.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: Ichigo tries to remove the impaled sword from the Soul King and save his life.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: Ukitake takes the place of the slain Soul King by releasing the power of Mimihagi.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Yhwach is overflowing with power from having absorbed the Soul King.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: The Soul Reapers regroup to prepare their counterattack against the Quincies.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: Yhwach builds his new castle, Wahr Welt.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: Kenpachi and Mayuri's group advance through Vier Ast.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: The change in Mayuri's Spiritual Pressure is also felt elsewhere by Urahara and Kyoraku.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: Nemu ignores Mayuri's orders by intervening in his battle against Pernida.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: Lille undergoes further transformation to hunt down and pass judgment on Kyoraku.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 38
episodes_data.description: As the battle between the soul reapers and the quincies rages, Haschwalt finds himself confronted by Bazz-B inside Wahrwelt

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: Kyoraku has paved the way for the soul reapers to reach the enemy's stronghold within Wahrwelt, but Gerard Valkyrie prevents them from advancing any further.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 40
episodes_data.description: Haschwalt suddenly attacks Uryu to pass judgement. The ensuing explosion and smoke draw Ichigo to the scene where he and Uryu are reunited.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 41
episodes_data.description: Ichigo, Orihime and Chad head out to defeat Yhwach while Yoruichi clashes with Nakk Le Vaar.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 42
episodes_data.description: The battle between Nakk Le Vaar, Yoruichi and Urahara rages and Ichigo and Orihime confront Yhwach.

episodes_data.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Season 2 Episode 43
episodes_data.description: Ichigo and Orihime confront Yhwach in a battle that will shape the fate of the Three Worlds.
